title: Further Reformed concession — substance of faith not always verbatim, often by consequence
source_text: XXI. Ultro quoque fatemur illa ipsa quae pertinent ad substantiam & corpus fidei & religionis in Scriptura non contineri verbatim & expresse, sive immediate, sed multa fidei dogmata solummodo ex Scriptura per bonam & legitimam consequentiam deduci.
pass_a_gloss: We freely confess as well that those very things which belong to the substance and body of faith and religion are not contained in Scripture word for word and expressly, or immediately, but that many dogmas of faith are drawn from Scripture only by a good and legitimate consequence.
pass_b_english: Further concession: the substance and body of faith and religion are not always in Scripture verbatim, expressly, or immediately.
Many faith dogmas come only by good and lawful consequence from Scripture.

choices.why: Keeps Latin adverb; pairs with expresse/immediate.
Same consequence lane as earlier Plenitudine sufficiency claims.
